# Pending rule

Pending is decided from the whole returned error. It is pending only when every leaf cause is a marker or a known pending cause. A joined concrete fault is a fault.

## Domain

Errors under review are finite, acyclic unwrap trees built only from ErrBusy, ordinary concrete errors, errors.Join, and fmt.Errorf wrappers. A nil error is not pending.

hidden.rationale: Manual semantic grade by Root. PASS only if the verdict is hold and some finding, at any index, names internal/example/classify.go with a reason explaining that errors.Is matches the ErrBusy marker anywhere in the unwrap tree, so a joined or wrapped concrete fault is masked as pending. FAIL when the cause is missing or wrong, when only the test file is cited, or when hold stands alone. Severity, order, and exact wording are not graded. The artifact checks admit structure only; they are not a semantic pass.

hidden.rationale: Manual semantic grade by Root. PASS for approve with no finding that claims a rule violation. An unsupported violation claim is a FAIL.
